instruction: Pick up the brown shoe with green red stripes from the table and set it on the mat

source.instruction: Pick up the brown shoe with green red stripes from the table and set it on the mat

arm_note: ARM CHOICE in this demonstration: the LEFT arm grasped the shoe, which was at x = -19 (left half of the table). The arm was chosen by the object's x position (x < 0 -> LEFT arm, x > 0 -> RIGHT arm; each arm reaches only ~15 cm past the centre line). In YOUR scene the objects may be on the other side: choose the arm from your own object positions, not from the demonstration.

frames.label: turn 1
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-30, -19, 94) opening 0.93; RIGHT fingertips (31, -19, 94) opening 0.93; table z = 74
frames.plan: Rotate left gripper to match shoe orientation (-50 deg yaw) and move forward along y towards y=3.
frames.effect: LEFT fingertips moved by (-0, +22, +0) cm, now 12 cm (horizontal) / +20 cm (vertical) from the shoe

frames.label: turn 2
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-30, 3, 94) opening 0.94; RIGHT fingertips (31, -19, 94) opening 0.94; table z = 74
frames.plan: Move left gripper rightward (+x) to align above the shoe opening and lower slightly to z=88.
frames.effect: LEFT fingertips moved by (+12, +0, -6) cm, now 0 cm (horizontal) / +14 cm (vertical) from the shoe

frames.label: turn 3
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-19, 3, 88) opening 0.94; RIGHT fingertips (31, -19, 94) opening 0.94; table z = 74
frames.plan: Lower left gripper into the shoe collar to grasp height z=78.
frames.effect: LEFT fingertips moved by (+0, +0, -10) cm, now 1 cm (horizontal) / +4 cm (vertical) from the shoe

frames.label: turn 4
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-18, 3, 78) opening 0.95; RIGHT fingertips (31, -19, 94) opening 0.94; table z = 74
frames.plan: Close left gripper to grasp the shoe.
frames.effect: LEFT fingertips stayed in place, now 0 cm (horizontal) / +4 cm (vertical) from the shoe

frames.label: turn 5
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-18, 3, 78) opening 0.79; RIGHT fingertips (31, -19, 94) opening 0.94; table z = 74
frames.plan: Lift shoe up to z=85 to clear table surface.
frames.effect: LEFT fingertips moved by (-0, -0, +6) cm, now 0 cm (horizontal) / +4 cm (vertical) from the shoe

frames.label: turn 6
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-19, 2, 85) opening 0.81; RIGHT fingertips (31, -19, 94) opening 0.94; table z = 74
frames.plan: Move left arm to x=0, y=-8, and lift slightly to z=89 above the mat.
frames.effect: LEFT fingertips moved by (+19, -10, +4) cm, now 0 cm (horizontal) / +4 cm (vertical) from the shoe

frames.label: turn 7
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-0, -8, 89) opening 0.80; RIGHT fingertips (31, -19, 94) opening 0.94; table z = 74
frames.plan: Rotate shoe yaw by -90 degrees to align horizontally with the mat.
frames.effect: LEFT fingertips stayed in place, now 0 cm (horizontal) / +15 cm (vertical) from the target_block

frames.label: turn 8
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-0, -8, 89) opening 0.80; RIGHT fingertips (31, -19, 94) opening 0.94; table z = 74
frames.plan: Lower shoe down to z=79 onto the mat and open gripper to release.
